text: ok so whatever data you just gathered by tapping into the selected face, i literally see none of it. so thats the task, i would like to see in the ui whatever data you get when you pull the data of the face i have selected, for any face / selection of faces / selection of verts / edges. I am completely blind to all of it
resolution: Added a host-native selection snapshot and a visible SELECTION section in Model Focus. Vertex selections show ids, positions, and part ownership; edges show endpoint ids/positions, length, incidence, open/closed state, and part; authored faces show grouped triangle/vertex ids, semantic name/id/instance, normal, area, material, part, pivot, and bounds. Exact totals are always visible, large detail sets are honestly capped and scrollable, and Agent Seat programmatic selections now notify the same UI. Added strict TS boundary validation/grouping tests plus Zig face/edge/vertex snapshot coverage; ReleaseFast editor build passes.
